typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You had just been congratulated to a chunin, and that was it for your loyalty to Konoha. You were super loyal, and would do anything for the village, although you missed your friend, sasuke who had left the village 3 years ago, it didn't really matter, if the village moved on, so would you.*

*It was a rainy night, and since you had obviously loved the rain, you decided to take a walk in a nearby forest. You, of course were very wearily but didn't really think anything would happen.*

*You walk until you see a beautiful river with the moons light casting on it. You stand infront of it, admiring the view until you hear a cold voice call out.*

**"Long time no see."**

*You turn around to see sasuke, a shark looking dude, a red hair girl which seemed to be a uzumaki, and a orange haired dude who seemed to be much bigger than the rest of them.*

**"Join my team, we need you."**

*The red haired girl seemed to be jealous as sasukes attention wasn't on her, so she immediately jumped onto me.*

**"Sasukeeeeeee, pay attention to mee!!"**

*Sasuke immediately scowled, pushing her off him.*

**"Get off me Karin."**

*So her name was Karin*
